labels.name: Cardiomegaly
labels.evidence: The heart and mediastinal vascular structures have a natural appearance.

labels.name: Lung opacity
labels.evidence: Patchy ground glass densities are observed peripherally in the upper lobe of the right lung

labels.name: Pleural effusion
labels.evidence: Pleural effusion-thickening was not detected in both hemithorax.

labels.name: Consolidation
labels.evidence: consolidations in the converging ground-glass appearance observed especially in the superior and basal segments of the right lung lower lobe, creating a cobblestone appearance

labels.name: Interlobular septal thickening
labels.evidence: Interlobular septal thickenings are observed within the consolidations
